test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 29 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A sum of Rs. 10,000 is borrowed at a rate of simple interest 15% per annum. Find the interest to be paid at the end of two years.
solution:
**Given:**

P = Rs 10,000 

Rate = 15% per annum 

**Formula used:**

S.I. = ( P × R × T) /100 

Where, S.I. = Simple Interest, P = Principal, R = Rate of interest, T = Time in years

**Calculation:**

Here, P = 10,000 , R = 15% , T = 2 years

⇒ S.I. = ( P × R × T) /100 = ( 10000 × 15 × 2 ) /100 = 3,000

**Hence, interest to be paid at the end of 2 years are Rs 3,000.**
